ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with a low white-to-black ratio, approximately 1:6 based on visible surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to high-relief, upward-curving distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rugose, high-intensity calcified clusters localized on the distal extremities of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple hollow-circle pigmentation patterns (rings) localized predominantly on the right fluke lobe.
